title.es: Proyecto de escritura: borrador y edición

es: Editar un borrador corrigiendo formas, registro y conectores (although, however, therefore, whereas), evitar el comma splice y justificar los cambios.

vocabulary.es: revisar una última vez, corregir pruebas
coma que une dos oraciones completas

teaching.en: I always leave a draft for a day before I edit it, because mistakes are much easier to spot with fresh eyes.
teaching.es: Siempre dejo un borrador un día antes de corregirlo, porque los errores se ven mucho mejor con ojos frescos.
teaching.explanationEs: Draft y edit: primero escribes una versión y luego la editas por pasadas: formas, registro y conectores.
segments: I always leave a draft for a day before I edit
it, because mistakes are much easier to spot with fresh eyes.
teaching.audioText: I always leave a draft for a day before I edit it, because mistakes are much easier to spot with fresh eyes.

teaching.en: Although the first version was clear, it was full of slang, so I had to tone down the language before sending it to the client.
teaching.es: Aunque la primera versión era clara, estaba llena de jerga, así que tuve que suavizar el lenguaje antes de enviarla al cliente.
teaching.explanationEs: Although + oración, oración: no lleva but. Tone down es suavizar un tono demasiado directo o coloquial.
segments: Although the first version was clear, it was full of slang, so I
had to tone down the language before sending it to the client.
teaching.audioText: Although the first version was clear, it was full of slang, so I had to tone down the language before sending it to the client.

teaching.en: The trial succeeded; however, the sample was small, and my first draft, with a comma instead of a semicolon before however, was a comma splice.
teaching.es: La prueba tuvo éxito; sin embargo, la muestra era pequeña, y mi primer borrador, con una coma en lugar de un punto y coma antes de however, era un comma splice.
teaching.explanationEs: However une dos oraciones: punto y coma antes y coma después. Con una coma sola se produce un comma splice.
segments: The trial succeeded; however, the sample was small, and my first draft, with
a comma instead of a semicolon before however, was a comma splice.
teaching.audioText: The trial succeeded; however, the sample was small, and my first draft, with a comma instead of a semicolon before however, was a comma splice.

teaching.en: Fuel prices rose sharply; therefore, many households cut back, whereas wealthier families barely noticed the difference.
teaching.es: Los precios del combustible subieron bruscamente; por lo tanto, muchos hogares gastaron menos, mientras que las familias más ricas casi no notaron la diferencia.
teaching.explanationEs: Therefore introduce la consecuencia con la misma puntuación que however; whereas contrasta dos grupos dentro de una oración.
segments: Fuel prices rose sharply; therefore, many households cut
back, whereas wealthier families barely noticed the difference.
teaching.audioText: Fuel prices rose sharply; therefore, many households cut back, whereas wealthier families barely noticed the difference.

teaching.en: A casual message to a colleague sounds friendly, but the same wording may seem careless in a report, so reword it carefully.
teaching.es: Un mensaje informal a un colega suena amistoso, pero las mismas palabras pueden parecer descuidadas en un informe, así que reformúlalo con cuidado.
teaching.explanationEs: Casual describe el registro informal; reword es decir lo mismo con otras palabras, más adecuadas al lector.
segments: A casual message to a colleague sounds friendly, but the same
wording may seem careless in a report, so reword it carefully.
teaching.audioText: A casual message to a colleague sounds friendly, but the same wording may seem careless in a report, so reword it carefully.

teaching.en: When you proofread your final draft, look for every sentence fragment, because a group of words without a main verb often passes for a full sentence.
teaching.es: Cuando revises tu borrador final, busca cada fragmento de oración, porque un grupo de palabras sin verbo principal suele parecer una oración completa a simple vista.
teaching.explanationEs: Proofread es la última lectura, centrada en errores pequeños; un sentence fragment es un trozo de frase que se presenta como si fuera una oración.

group of words without a main verb often passes for a full sentence.

prompt.es: Elige la corrección de «Although the lanes are cheap, but they are narrow».

choices.text: Although the lanes are cheap, however, they are narrow.
Although the lanes are cheap, they are narrow.
Although the lanes are cheap; they are narrow.

feedback.es: Although ya expresa el contraste: la segunda parte no lleva but ni however, y tampoco va separada con punto y coma.

hint.es: Con although no se necesita otro conector en la segunda parte.

origin.text: Draft report: The new cycling scheme is a total mess. Although the lanes are cheap, but they are narrow; however the council built them anyway. The kids who ride to school hate them, therefore fewer of them are cycling. Some parents like the lanes, whereas others is worried about the traffic. Honestly, the whole plan is a bit rubbish and needs fixing fast.

prompt.es: Completa: «La muestra era pequeña; sin embargo, los autores siguen cautos.»

feedback.es: However (o nevertheless) une dos oraciones con contraste: punto y coma antes y coma después.

hint.es: Es el conector de contraste que aparece entre dos oraciones completas.

origin.text: The trial was a success. The sample was small; ___, the authors remain cautious.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Muchos hogares gastaron menos, mientras que otros casi no lo notaron.»

answer.text: Many households cut back whereas others barely noticed the difference
accepted: Many households cut back whereas others barely noticed the difference
Whereas many households cut back others barely noticed the difference

feedback.es: Whereas contrasta los dos grupos dentro de la misma oración, sin punto y coma.

hint.es: Whereas une las dos partes sin punto y coma.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada conector con la función que cumple en la frase.

pairs: Although the plan is cheap, it is slow.

pairs.es: concesión al inicio de la frase

pairs: The plan is cheap; however, it is slow.
Some like the plan, whereas others oppose it.

feedback.es: Although concede al inicio, however contrasta entre oraciones, therefore presenta el resultado y whereas opone dos grupos.

pairs.es: concesión al inicio de la frase

pairs: The plan is cheap; however, it is slow.

prompt.es: Elige la versión formal y bien puntuada de la frase del borrador.

choices.text: The kids who cycle to school dislike the lanes; therefore fewer of them cycle.
The children who cycle to school hate the lanes, therefore, fewer of them cycle.
The children who cycle to school dislike the lanes; therefore, fewer of them cycle.

feedback.es: Children y dislike elevan el registro, y therefore entre dos oraciones lleva punto y coma antes y coma después.

origin.text: Draft report: The new cycling scheme is a total mess. Although the lanes are cheap, but they are narrow; however the council built them anyway. The kids who ride to school hate them, therefore fewer of them are cycling. Some parents like the lanes, whereas others is worried about the traffic. Honestly, the whole plan is a bit rubbish and needs fixing fast.

prompt.es: Completa el informe con el conector adecuado en cada espacio.

feedback.es: Therefore introduce la consecuencia del éxito del piloto y although concede que los datos son alentadores sin cerrar el tema.

sentences: The pilot scheme was a success; ___, several councils have copied it.
___ the evidence is encouraging, more data would help.

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender la tutora sobre el borrador?

choices.text: That its content is sound, but its register is too casual for a board.
That its content is sound, but it is too long for a board to read.
That its register is right, but its evidence needs to be better organised.

feedback.es: Elogia el argumento y las pruebas, pero dice que suena a mensaje a un amigo: el contenido es bueno y falla el registro; no habla de la extensión ni de la organización de las pruebas.

origin.text: Tutor's comment on a student essay: The argument is sound, and the evidence is well chosen. Even so, the piece reads more like a message to a friend than a report for the board; a little more care with register would go a long way.

prompt.es: Completa: «Por favor, suaviza el lenguaje antes de que enviemos el segundo correo.»

feedback.es: Tone down es el verbo frasal para suavizar un tono demasiado directo antes de enviar el mensaje.

origin.text: The client found our first email too direct. Please ___ down the language before we send the second one.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Aunque el informe es breve, contiene pruebas sólidas.»

answer.text: Although the report is short it contains strong evidence
accepted: Although the report is short it contains strong evidence
It contains strong evidence although the report is short

feedback.es: Although abre la concesión y no admite but en la segunda parte: la frase sigue con it contains.

prompt.es: Corrige el borrador (seis errores) y justifica dos cambios con «because».

answer.text: Dear Ms Clark, the children in my class were very excited about the trip. Although the tickets were expensive, we are going to go anyway. The museum is free; however, it closes early; therefore, we must leave at two. I changed kids to children because a formal letter needs a neutral register, and I removed but because although already shows the contrast.
accepted: Dear Ms Clark, the children in my class were very excited about the trip. Although the tickets were expensive, we are going to go anyway. The museum is free; however, it closes early; therefore, we must leave at two. I changed kids to children because a formal letter needs a neutral register, and I removed but because although already shows the contrast.

Dear Ms Clark, the pupils in my class were very excited about the trip. Although the tickets were costly, we are going to go anyway. The museum is free; nevertheless, it closes early; as a result, we must leave at two. I replaced kids with pupils because a formal letter needs a neutral register, and I deleted but because although already shows the contrast.

feedback.es: Un buen borrador editado usa children, were y going to; corrige although sin but; puntúa however y therefore con punto y coma y coma, y explica dos cambios con because.

origin.text: Borrador: «Dear Ms Clark, the kids in my class was very excited about the trip. Although the tickets were pricey, but we are gonna go anyway. The museum is free, however it closes early, therefore we must leave at two.» Reescríbelo en un registro formal, corrige la concordancia y los conectores y añade dos frases que justifiquen dos cambios (empieza con I changed… o I removed…).

prompt.es: ¿Con qué propósito cambia el editor «kids» y «gonna»?

choices.text: To correct two errors of form that would have confused the board.
To stop the informal wording from distracting the board from strong findings.
To make the report sound more confident about its findings.

feedback.es: El editor lo aclara: los hallazgos son fuertes y no quiere que una frase informal distraiga; es un cambio de registro, no de gramática ni de tono de seguridad.

origin.text: Editor's note: I have replaced kids with children and gonna with going to. The findings are strong, and I do not want a casual phrase to distract the board from them.

prompt.es: Completa: «Antes de enviarlo, revisa con cuidado tu informe final.»

feedback.es: Proofread es la última lectura, centrada en errores pequeños, antes de entregar el texto final.

origin.text: You have finished the final draft of your report. Before you send it, please ___ it carefully, because one small mistake can spoil a good report.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los resultados fueron alentadores; sin embargo, la muestra era pequeña.»

answer.text: The results were encouraging however the sample was small
accepted: The results were encouraging however the sample was small
The results were encouraging the sample however was small

feedback.es: However une las dos oraciones con contraste: los resultados son buenos y la muestra limita la conclusión.
